name: ARMOR-VOICE-AI
deployment_target: CM5 test bench (systemd) or any computer
notes: Closed allow-list of spoken intents in eight languages, service-issued signed single-use confirmation tokens for arm and disarm, and a decision-only audit (no audio, no raw text). The speech engines are programs the installation chooses (ARMOR_VOICE_STT_COMMAND, ARMOR_VOICE_TTS_COMMAND); none is installed with it.
